items.headline: Arkansas State scores final 10 points, holds off Kennesaw State for 17-14 win
items.description: — Trey Owens threw a touchdown pass and ran for another for Arkansas State, and the Red Wolves scored the last 10 points to beat Kennesaw State 17-14 on Saturday night.

items.headline: Jaden Craig throws 3 TD passes as sluggish TCU pulls away from Arkansas State 31-7
items.description: — Jaden Craig threw for 337 yards and three touchdowns, and TCU overcame a sluggish showing for a 31-7 victory over Arkansas State on Saturday night.
